context.text:
facilities maintenance tickets. Each row is a facilities service request logged by building occupants and routed to internal staff or external vendors for resolution. Operations managers use this data to track how quickly issues are resolved against SLA targets, how often requests escalate, and what repairs cost across buildings and request categories.
Likely metrics: mean time to resolve tickets; SLA compliance rate; ticket volume by category and building; total and average repair cost; escalation rate
